soldier: Head and antennae reddish yellow, nasus reddish brown with a paler base, the anterior part of the pronotum reddish brown and the posterior part slightly paler, legs and abdomen yellow. Head with sparse long hairs, the tip of the nasus densely haired, the abdomen with many hairs. Head nearly pear-shaped, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin concave in the middle; nasus tubular, projecting forwards and slightly upturned in profile; mandibular teeth inconspicuous. Antennae with 13 segments, the second, third and fourth of moderate length, the third longest, the second next, the fourth shortest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior part upturned, the anterior margin concave in the middle. Small soldier: the colour and chaetotaxy of all parts as in the large soldier, the head shape similar but narrower and smaller, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave; when the antennae have 12 segments the third is slender and long, longer than the second, equal to or slightly shorter than the fourth; individuals with 13 segments also occur.
